title: llm-on-a-stick task
description: One benchmark task. Lives at <section>/<task-id>/task.yaml (built-in or user-provided).

section.description: The group of tasks it is run with (`stick run --section`): a tool such as netbox, or cfg-mgmt. Wider groupings (SoT/DDI...) are listed in sections/README.md.

floor.description: The section's cheap floor task (one per section): it shows a model can use the tool at all, and CI validates it on every change to shared code.

prompt.description: Jinja template rendered with topology vars and canary values.

topology.description: Built-in topology name or path to a .clab.yml file; `none` for a task that needs no lab devices (the lab needn't be running).

tools.description: What the model works with. Absent: a shell in the toolbox (run_command). With `mcp`: only the tools of those services' MCP servers (each must be in requires.services and have an `mcp:` block in its service.yaml), plus submit_answer, which writes the answer to answer.json in the workspace.

canaries.description: Random values seeded per run so memorised or invented answers fail.

setup.description: Script (relative to the task dir) that prepares the initial state.

oracle.description: Reference solution script; `stick task validate` requires it to PASS.

type.description: Built-in check name (e.g. bgp_session) or plugin check.

reset_services.description: Services restored to their seeded snapshot before setup (e.g. [netbox]), so every attempt starts the same.

allowed_changes.description: Devices/services the agent may change; anything else changing is a collateral-change failure.

matrix.description: Parameterised variants: each combination becomes its own task.
